subject: dsa
title: Min Stack
summary: A normal stack, except each entry also records the smallest value at or below it. getMin just reads the top entry's record — no scanning.
problem: Design a stack that also returns its minimum value in O(1) at any time.

steps.caption: Push 5. The stack is [5] and the min is 5. Tag this entry with min = 5 (the highlighted cell marks the current min).
Push 3 — smaller, so the new min is 3. Tag this entry with min = 3.
Push 7. The min stays 3, so 7's entry is tagged min = 3 too.
getMin? Read the min tagged on the top entry: 3. No scanning.
Pop removes 7. The new top is 3, tagged min 3 — getMin is still instant.
Because each entry carries its own min, push, pop, and getMin are all O(1).
